The slope of line l passing through points A(1, -2) and B(3, 4) is calculated as follows:
slope(l) = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1) = (4 - (-2)) / (3 - 1) = 6 / 2 = 3

The slope of line PQ passing through points P(8, 1) and Q(12, 12) is calculated as follows:
slope(PQ) = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1) = (12 - 1) / (12 - 8) = 11 / 4

Since the slopes of line l (3) and line PQ (11/4) are not equal, the lines are not parallel. Parallel lines must have the same slope.

Therefore, the line l is not parallel with PQ.
